question.text: Number of points having distance $\sqrt{5}$ fron the straight line $x-2 y+1=0$ and a distance $\sqrt{13}$ from the line $2 x+3 y-1=0,$ is

solution.text:
Let the point be $(h, k)$
Then, $\left|\frac{h-2 k+1}{\sqrt{1^{2}+(-2)^{2}}}\right|=\sqrt{5}$
$h-2 k+1=\pm 5$
Also, $\left|\frac{2 h+3 k-1}{\sqrt{2^{2}+3^{2}}}\right|=$
$\Rightarrow \quad 2 h+3 k-1=\pm 13$
